default.description: Minimal capability set for the Partnera Business desktop thin client. Deny-by-default: the loaded web content (the Business consoles served by the central API over HTTPS) uses NO Tauri IPC. External-link opening and navigation control are handled in Rust, so no filesystem, shell, http, process, or opener permission is exposed to web content. Only core window defaults are granted.

updater-window.description: Capability for the local `updater` window only (updater.html, tauri:// scheme). It needs core IPC to invoke the update commands and to listen for `updater://status` progress events. Deliberately scoped to this window so the remote Business console loaded in `main` never gains these permissions, and no updater-plugin permission is exposed to web content — the check/download/install flow is driven from Rust.
